title: Tom Burnaby: A Story of Uganda and the Great Congo Forest

Determined to accompany him, Tom's resolve is met with disapproval due to his inexperience. After witnessing the cruel treatment of a black boy, Mbutu, at the hands of a Portuguese overseer, Tom intervenes, establishing a bond with the boy. Mbutu reveals a potential plot against Major Burnaby's expedition, urging Tom to act. Enthralled by the impending adventure and the risks ahead, Tom sets off on a journey to warn his uncle, showcasing his growth from a naive youth to a more determined and resourceful character.
